content:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small docs PR to add an 'Air-gapped installer: KMS migration' troubleshooting section. Focus is networking gotchas + an SDK proxy snippet. Looking for one infra reviewer and one docs reviewer.

ajay: thanks — can you paste the PR link here when it's up? also call out any changes that affect the existing installer flags so we can coordinate with release notes.

maria: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — it's a draft for now. Main things: 1) clarify required outbound ranges for KMS key retrieval during initial bootstrap, 2) provide iptables + nft examples for SNAT in private clusters, 3) add an SDK snippet showing HTTPS_PROXY for the KMS SDK.

sam: re: SNAT examples — we should call out MTU/fragmentation issues for HSM providers over UDP (some HSMs use CMP over UDP). small note could save someone hours.

rafael: agree. I'll paste a short iptables example that people can adapt. we should also show the nft equivalent.

rafael: ```
# SNAT example (iptables)
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
# Persist in /etc/iptables/rules.v4 or equivalent

# nftables equivalent
nft add table ip nat
nft add chain ip nat postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100 ; }
nft add rule ip nat postrouting oifname "eth0" counter masquerade
```

maria: perfect, add that to the troubleshooting section with a short caption about when to prefer nft vs iptables. i'll include your snippet.

docs-bot: automated link-checker: found 1 broken link in /installers/airgap.md -> /old-kms-setup.md (line 78). Suggested action: update to /private/kms-setup.md or mark as removed.

ajay: the broken link is from an older migration guide — we should update the anchor and add a redirect note. also pinging release team if any installer flags are being removed.

maria: noted. i'll replace the link and add a short migration note: "if you previously used --use_kms_proxy, switch to KMS_PROXY_URL and TLS_* env vars". adding a deprecation callout.

sam: for the SDK snippet, can you include both curl and Go examples? A minimal curl check is handy in air-gapped envs. e.g.:

sam: ```
# curl check via proxy
export HTTPS_PROXY="http://10.0.0.5:3128"
curl -v --proxy "$HTTPS_PROXY" https://kms.example.local/healthz
```

maria: adding curl + Go snippet. Go snippet (very small):

maria: ```go
client := http.Client{
  Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment},
}
req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://kms.example.local/healthz", nil)
resp, err := client.Do(req)
// handle resp/err
```

rafael: also suggest adding a short test plan section: what to verify post-migration (key fetch logs, TLS handshake, HSM reachability). i'll add bullets.

maria: will split PR into two commits: snippets + troubleshooting in first, link fixes + deprecation note in second. i'm planning to request reviews from @ajay and @rafael tomorrow. anyone else we should tag?

ajay: cc @ops-oncall for HSM/latency checks, and maybe @security for the KMS env var guidance.

sam: i can run quick local verification of the curl checks and checksum of the offline bundle after your changes — post the bundle link and i'll test.

maria: thanks all — moving to draft->ready for review later today. tagging reviewers in the PR and adding a short changelog entry. :eyes:
